description: Plan v7 section 8.3's browser chooser, supported {zh, zh-Hant} plus en and fr, tiebreaker zh:[zh, zh-Hant], fallback en. Content-identical to ingress-smoke-browser-chooser by design: it is the baseline half of a reversal pair whose other half, browser-chooser-zh-chooser-reversed, differs ONLY in tiebreaker order, so any case whose answer depends on that order shows a different result across the two and any case that does not must show the same one.
